source_description: Implements GitHub issue #376 — remove the v1 [Felix-Escalation] comment-write path that was left over from the #309 escalation→JSONL migration's soak-window parity scaffolding. Scope expanded during /specify (2026-06-02) to also delete the now-orphaned backfill_jsonl_from_comments.py migration tool, per Kent's no-vestiges principle being codified at #514. Mission also updates the agent prompt artifacts, runbook, and architecture data flow entries.
